name: From a named piece of work to its design
outcome: The product owner runs three plays on a business intent and gets a slice to test, a plan with one epic and one story for each feature, and an eval that no builder can read.

surface.name: the Claude Code command line
surface.user_action: runs /shape-slice, then /shape-plan, then /shape-eval on a business intent, and confirms each one

why_this_order: /shape-plan needs the slice that /shape-slice writes, and /shape-eval needs the epic and stories of the plan and the slice's hidden file. So the product owner can test each play only after the play before it has run.

left_out.what: fn-727 (build the plan tree) and fn-728 (create or link the epic and story issues), the older features of cap-718
left_out.why: They serve bi-717, not bi-788. fn-818 holds what this intent needs from the plan: the plan file, one epic and one story for each feature.

left_out.what: The loop that runs the three plays and its one approval (#796)
left_out.why: The proof asks that each of the three plays ends at its own confirmation; fn-795 puts the loop out of scope.
Until it exists, a read rule keeps builders out of the evals folder; fn-798 and cap-shape-eval put encryption out of scope.

left_out.what: The design, build, test or validation of an epic (#819), the release plays, /learn-outcomes and the upgrade of an older product model (#835)
left_out.why: The intent's Must not excludes them.

left_out.what: Running the eval after the build
left_out.why: The intent asks for the eval to be written before the build, not run; fn-798 puts running it out of scope.

decisions.question: Which surface does the tester use?
decisions.answer: the Claude Code command line, where the product owner runs the three plays

decisions.question: Who tests the slice there?
decisions.answer: the product owner, who names the work and confirms each part

decisions.question: Which features does the slice need?
decisions.answer: fn-795 (/shape-slice writes the slice and its hidden file), fn-818 (/shape-plan writes the plan, the epic and the stories) and fn-798 (/shape-eval writes the hidden eval)
